post.description: Creates a user account, returns an access token and sets the refresh cookie. Limited per client IP, with login: 429 with Retry-After beyond the limit.
Authenticates a user, returns an access token and sets the refresh cookie. Limited per client IP, with register: 429 with Retry-After beyond the limit.
Exchanges the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new refresh cookie. A refresh token used twice revokes its whole sign-in. Requires the X-Requested-With header.
Revokes the sign-in of the refresh cookie and clears it. Requires the X-Requested-With header.

get.description: Returns the user attached to the bearer token.

post.description: Creates a workspace and adds the authenticated user as OWNER.

get.description: Lists only workspaces where the authenticated user is a member.
Returns a workspace only when the user belongs to it.

delete.description: Deletes a workspace. Only OWNER members can delete.

post.description: Adds the authenticated user as MEMBER using a one-time invitation code.
Creates a one-time invitation code. Only OWNER members can invite.

get.description: Lists members only when the authenticated user belongs to the workspace.

delete.description: Removes a MEMBER from the workspace. Only OWNER members can remove members.

post.description: Creates a project inside a workspace where the user is a member.

get.description: Lists projects only within the requested workspace membership scope.
Returns a project only when it belongs to the requested workspace and user membership scope.

patch.description: Updates project metadata, owner, or lifecycle status when the user is allowed to manage the project.

delete.description: Archives a project in workspace scope. Workspace owners or project owners can archive.
Permanently deletes a project in workspace scope. Only workspace OWNER members can delete permanently.

get.description: Returns every template with its lists and example cards.
Returns a full board with lists, cards, labels, and assignees.

post.description: Creates a project board and generates lists from the selected template.

get.description: Returns graph-derived planning signals for the board.
Returns the signed-in user's planning preferences for the board, or the defaults when none are saved.

put.description: Replaces the signed-in user's planning preferences for the board. Fields left out take their default.

patch.description: Renames a list, changes its task status or moves it. A status change completes or reopens its cards, as moving them would.

delete.description: Deletes a list. Its cards move to the list given by moveCardsTo, which is required when it has cards.

get.description: Returns safe dependency suggestions, blockers, and impacted dependents.

patch.description: Replaces the comment's text and records editedAt. Only the author can edit (403 for others).

delete.description: Deletes the comment. Only the author or a workspace OWNER can delete (403 for others).

get.description: Ranks the signed-in user's cards across the workspace's active projects: what they are working on, what they can start next, and what is blocked. Each card keeps the score and reasons of its board's planning view.
